name: Verdant Engine
purpose: Universal 3D browser and WebAssembly game engine mechanized with Prism, exact uor-matmul tensor contractions, progressive UORC streaming, glTF 2.0, portable WGSL, rigid-body physics, and spatial audio.

promise.headline: Self-verifying 3D worlds, formal UI, neuromorphic mutual attention, and Stitch multiplayer in every browser.
promise.detail: Every pass reduces to exact uor-matmul semiring contractions, zero-decode UORC progressive streams, WCAG-proved UI layout, local coded_gemm reasoning, and 2-of-3 Stitch parity custody.

claim: VE-10: the engine verifier answers conformant only for monotonic progressive UORC streaming LODs and overflow-safe uor-matmul tensor kernels, refuses zero-extent or narrow-accumulator contractions, and answers invalid request for unknown queries.

proposition.name: TensorKernelValid
proposition.text:
TensorKernelValid kernel :=
  0 < kernel.lhsCols
  /\ kernel.minAccumBits <= kernel.accumBits
  /\ 0 < kernel.minAccumBits
  /\ kernel.tileAligned = true

LodsMonotonic lods :=
  StrictResolutionAscent LOD0 -> LOD1 -> LOD2 -> LOD3 (lossless UORC)
proposition.plain: Every Prism-hosted engine tensor kernel satisfies exact Laurent or tropical accumulator bit-width bounds and tile alignment, while UORC scene frames stream strictly monotonically up to lossless source fidelity.
